name: recoverai
description: RecoverAI - AI-powered lost & stolen smartphone recovery coordinator

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/config && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/config && npm run typecheck -w packages/ui && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
